apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.4 — SequencePlayer migration Phase P-E (final): one tone engine and one SequencePlayer, built once in the app shell. Every studio adapter (scales, phrases, Varisai) wraps that shared player; per-studio stop guards keep a stop aimed at one studio from touching another's pass. This completes the SequencePlayer unification — one playback core for all swara sequences, with the song player and Tala clock separate as designed.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
